resources.string: Evens out the volume between tracks: turns very loud ones down and quiet ones up (up to +12 dB), with a soft limiter. On by default.
2:1 compression above −12 dB, with no make-up gain: gently lowers the loud passages to glue the mix together. Off by default.
Optional limiter and automatic headroom; no made-up “enhancements” on top of Opus
